0.content: Alvis and the Domovoy Izmaylov, who led the Royal Energy Commission, argued bitterly in every council session, so convincingly that some thought it staged. Over the railway's Transport Bureau, Alvis wanted a noble fae at its head while Izmaylov, who knew the Tsaritsa's wishes, listed only humans; Alvis stepped back to wait for Izmaylov to fail against the Burner of Cities. The young Domovoy instead forged weapons for the Luchkin, helped crush the rebellion and founded the High Table.

1.comment: Alvis: Hvergelmir and the betrayal of Aksinya
1.content: The Hvergelmir circle gathered under the Belyi Tsar to seek the vacant seat in the court of the stars. Alvis toasted Aksinya as its triumphant leader, though his old distrust of humans had never entirely left him. Later the Eye of Graeae, speaking as the Primordial Human, persuaded Alvis, Koshchei and Pavlina to divide him and throw Aksinya into the Shadow Realm.
